messages:
marta-csm: FYI Coastline (acct 8421) just told us they're expanding — new creative squad + sales enablement. They want embeddings for product content and a realtime summarizer for live briefs. onboarding at ~60% but QPS doubled in last 48h. thinking a short dedicated pilot? cc @devin-amey-sales @leo-ops

devin-amey-sales: awesome — are they asking for SLA or just proof-of-concept? any signal on contract length? :eyes:

marta-csm: not yet on SLA, renewal check is ~6 weeks out. they're nervous about latency after last week's hiccup. want next-week enablement sessions and a runway for a burst cap.

leo-ops: can we handle 2x sustained QPS from them on current shared clusters? pinging infra for a quick capacity check.

sam-platform: infra-bot ran a quick look — current shard has ~18% headroom but distribution skew likely. recommend: (1) enable prefix caching for their frequent prompts, (2) temp weight on dedicated pool if they hit sustained >1.5x for 12h.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: alert — 8421 observed 2xx -> 5xx spike at 2025-11-07T09:18:43Z, rate-limited by node-7. See logs: ```ERROR: kv-cache-miss ctx=8421 seq=0x7f3a```

marta-csm: thanks — can we draft a quick playbook for onboarding + burst steps? I'll share with them tomorrow. also capture feedback: they said model outputs were good, but latency and tail errors worry their product team.

devin-amey-sales: I'll prep a short renewal-risk note and pricing for a 3-month dedicated pilot (incl burst). want to run numbers with Optimize team.

leo-ops: checklist for next 48h: 1) enable prefix caching on their routes 2) run a targeted kv cache warm for top 50 prompts 3) provision a 2-node dedicated pool if QPS > 1.6x for 4h. I'll own #2 and #3.

marta-csm: great — I'll book enablement sessions: 1x architecture walkthrough w/ ops, 1x prompt-engineering clinic. collecting a small set of sample prompts for the clinic.

devin-amey-sales: do we have an approximate cost delta for a short dedicated pilot vs shared w/ burst? need to give them a ballpark today.

sam-platform: ballpark: dedicated 2x nodes ~= +$9k/mo; short pilot (3 months) we can discount. with caching + batching they should see ~35% token-cost reduction.

marta-csm: capture: account health = yellow (expansion interest but renewal risk if latency persists). action items: marta -> collect prompts + schedule clinics, leo -> kv warm + watch QPS, sam -> pricing + infra plan, devin -> renewal note and pilot terms.

devin-amey-sales: noted. I'll also surface customer asks to Product for any quick-performance wins that are low-effort.

marta-csm: thanks team — I'll update the Coastline contact tomorrow after enablement schedule is set. :thumbsup:
